The PortFast-only causal control. Every foundation dimension reads exactly as run 4, and so does every endpoint: no address 2/2, 0 voice bindings, NOT_REGISTERED 2/2, voice-VLAN phone STP rows still ABSENT.  PORTFAST = APPLIED but PORTFAST_READBACK = UNOBSERVABLE: the Type column still reads 'P2p' and this build has never been measured printing an edge marker, so NO_EFFECT is established for the applied edge policy, not for a switch demonstrably running PortFast.
